exception.justification: Justified: Protocol and secret-carrier trait plumbing inherits the enclosing host operation; re-observation would duplicate content or format secret state.

review.body: { f . debug_struct ("Session") . field ("store_link_case" , & "host-secured") . field ("connected" , & ! self . client . is_closed ()) . field ("private_state" , & "[REDACTED]") . field ("persistence" , & "disabled") . finish_non_exhaustive () }
review.item_premise: The private raw client has no production accessor. Role-only carriers protect configuration, keys and diagnostics; exact frame buffers stay secret-owned until the checked public filter. Public session formatting reveals only the declared case, connection state and disabled persistence.
